title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
statement: Given the root of a binary tree, return the number of nodes along the longest path from the root down to a leaf.
constraints: tree values do not affect the answer

editor_note.idea: The depth of a node is one plus the larger depth of its two children.
editor_note.data_structure_reason: Recursion matches the recursive structure of the tree.
editor_note.space_complexity: O(h), where h is the tree height
editor_note.edge_cases: The base case returns 0 for an empty subtree.
editor_note.pitfalls: Confusing number of edges with number of nodes leads to off-by-one errors.
